questions.text: Look at this series: 2, 1, (1/2), (1/4), ... What number should come next?
questions.explanation: Each number in the sequence is half of the preceding number (divided by 2). Half of 1/4 is 1/8.

questions.text: A family has 5 members: a father, mother, and three children. The average age of the family is 20 years. If the parents' average age is 35, what is the average age of the children?
questions.explanation: Total age of family = 5 * 20 = 100. Total age of parents = 2 * 35 = 70. Total age of children = 100 - 70 = 30. Average age of 3 children = 30 / 3 = 10 years.

questions.text: If 5 workers can build a wall in 12 days, how many days would it take 6 workers to build the same wall working at the same pace?
questions.explanation: The total work is measured in worker-days: 5 * 12 = 60 worker-days. To find the days for 6 workers: 60 / 6 = 10 days.

questions.text: Choose the word that is least like the other words in the group: Geometry, Algebra, Calculus, Physics, Thermodynamics.
questions.explanation: While Physics and Thermodynamics are sciences, and the others are purely math branches, let's look at the options. Physics is the odd one out among pure math branches listed.

questions.text: A train running at the speed of 60 km/hr crosses a pole in 9 seconds. What is the length of the train?
questions.explanation: Speed in m/s = 60 * (5/18) = 50/3 m/s. Distance (Length) = Speed * Time = (50/3) * 9 = 150 meters.

questions.text: If FRIEND is coded as HUMJTK, how is CANDLE coded in that same system?
questions.explanation: The pattern shifts each letter forward: F->H (+2), R->U (+3), I->M (+4), E->J (+5), N->T (+6), D->K (+7). Applying this to CANDLE gives EDRIRL.

questions.text: Find the odd one out among the following numbers: 27, 64, 125, 144, 216.
questions.explanation: All numbers are perfect cubes except 144, which is a perfect square (12^2).

questions.text: A person climbs a 10-meter pole. Each minute he climbs 3 meters up but slips down 2 meters. How long will it take him to reach the top?
questions.explanation: Each of the first 7 minutes, net progress is 1m. At the end of 7 minutes, he is at 7m. On the 8th minute, he climbs 3m to reach the top (10m) and does not slip.
